clues: This chief town sits on a big island in the far north of Canada. It is the largest town in its territory and the town farthest north in the land.
It has a polar climate, even though it lies well south of the Arctic Circle. Cold deep sea water just off the island keeps the city cold.
In 1999, this town was made the chief town of a brand new territory. The Northwest Territories had just split into two parts.
No roads or trains link this city to the rest of Canada. Ships can reach it for only part of the year, so goods from far away cost a lot.
Of all the chief towns in Canada, this one has the least folks. No chief town in the land has so few folks.
